challenge.en: Inbound from five sources landed in a spreadsheet. SDRs cherry-picked. Speed-to-lead sat at 14 hours. Marketing claimed pipeline; sales said it was junk.
challenge.es: El inbound de cinco fuentes caía en una spreadsheet. Los SDRs elegían a mano. Speed-to-lead: 14 horas. Marketing reivindicaba pipeline; ventas decía que era basura.

solution.en: We rebuilt routing, enrichment, and SLA clocks in HubSpot + n8n. Every lead got a score, an owner, and a first-touch deadline. Reporting used the same objects as the floor.
solution.es: Reconstruimos routing, enrichment y relojes de SLA en HubSpot + n8n. Cada lead tenía score, owner y deadline de primer toque. El reporting usaba los mismos objetos que el piso de ventas.

challenge.en: Outbound lived in three tools. Sequences fired twice. Territory rules were tribal knowledge. AEs spent Mondays cleaning duplicates instead of running meetings.
challenge.es: El outbound vivía en tres herramientas. Las secuencias se disparaban dos veces. Las reglas de territorio eran conocimiento tribal. Los AEs pasaban los lunes limpiando duplicados.

solution.en: One Apollo-to-CRM spine, Clay enrichment, and a Make layer for compliance holds. Territories encoded as data. Sequences became a single campaign object.
solution.es: Un spine Apollo-a-CRM, enrichment en Clay y una capa Make para holds de compliance. Territorios como datos. Las secuencias pasaron a ser un solo objeto de campaña.

challenge.en: A long-cycle product with a form that dumped into email. Partners could not see stage risk. Forecast was a spreadsheet updated on Sundays.
challenge.es: Producto de ciclo largo con un form que caía al email. Los partners no veían riesgo por etapa. El forecast era una spreadsheet actualizada los domingos.

solution.en: Lifecycle objects, partner-visible dashboards, and Slack alerts on stalled deals. The form became a qualified record with enrichment before a human touched it.
solution.es: Objetos de lifecycle, dashboards visibles para partners y alertas en Slack para deals estancados. El form pasó a ser un record calificado con enrichment antes de que lo tocara una persona.
